name: PulseAPI
free_limit: Forever-free hosted API monitoring: up to 20 HTTP/HTTPS endpoints, 1 team member, 1-minute checks, email alerts, and 7-day data retention.
watch_out: Free plan uses one monitoring location and community support; Slack/webhook alerts, API access and longer retention require paid plans. Commercial-use terms require verification; no card or per-check overage on Free.
